purpose: Compare one captured Android QNN video-model tensor against a PC CPU ONNX Runtime result using exactly the Android-captured input bytes. This is a numerical-comparison gate, not a full P4 real-image qualification or a display-pipeline quality claim.

numerical_comparison.qualificationBoundary: The threshold is reused only to report an observed tensor comparison. It does not unfreeze P4 input/SSIM requirements or qualify full-frame/video/display quality.

lanczos_baseline.implementation: host Pillow RGB8 Lanczos from the exact captured NCHW input
lanczos_baseline.purpose: Record a reproducible host-side traditional-upscaling artifact alongside the PC CPU golden.
lanczos_baseline.not_equivalent_to: Media3/GPU presentation timing or pixel-identical display output

storage.committable: source, contracts, tests, and sanitized summaries only
